decisions.rationale: Explicit authorized issue20 continuation. Historical no-cart/no-checkout catalog scope is superseded only for this bounded shopper feature; price, Inventory, payment and order authority remain upstream.

Identify remaining Core contract and distinguish local package/browser fixtures from Registry installation or real TEST checkout. No independent pricing/order/stock/provider authority or deployment/grant changes.

decisions.choice: Adopt exact review-qualified pre-release Commerce49 source and immutable npm/Registry artifacts against merged Template28, retaining unmerged versus merged identity until owner receipt. Prove the immutable default backend through original EmDash workerd owner context, versioned settings, encrypted synthetic credential and canonical storage CAS, integrated with immutable Payments12 Worker and intercepted issuer/provider. Preserve frozen pricing, one durable order/coupon effect, restart/replay and wake-after-settlement ACK. Empty shipped grants and unconfigured profiles fail closed; default public checkout stays disabled. No Registry publication/delivery, credential lookup/real identity renewal, grant/account/provider/deployment changes or scheduler registration claim. Preserve required zero-order then product-page owner queue.

decisions.choice: Proposal: migrate the merchandise collection to products with urlPattern /products/{slug}, SEO enabled, preserved seed slugs, and a required commerceItemId; add a collections collection with slashless unique slugs, SEO enabled, and /collections/{slug}; product URLs remain flat and never nested.

decisions.choice: Proposal: legacy /shop/{id}, old digest collection paths, /home, and slash variants redirect with 302 and no-store until verified, then may become 301; never use immutable or long max-age redirect caching. Slug edits use the EmDash redirect table.

decisions.rationale: Conservative redirect rollout avoids caching an incorrect canonical while satisfying one slashless URL.

decisions.choice: Proposal: starter stores are indexable by default and use EmDash built-in sitemap.xml and robots.txt; demo-host noindex is explicit runtime configuration only, not the default.

decisions.choice: Proposal: an unlinked Commerce item, an item without a published products entry, an invalid/duplicate link, and a non-listable or unpriced public lookup all return 404/no public URL; no invented slug, fallback page, draft fallback, or alternate /shop URL.
decisions.question: How should unlinked or non-public Commerce items behave?
decisions.rationale: Fail-closed behavior prevents ambiguous canonical URLs and keeps Commerce authoritative.
